scope.protected_scope: China and every existing country or territory not listed above

source_policy.geometry_rule: Do not ingest geometry unless the authoritative publisher states a reusable license and the source can be reproduced exactly.
source_policy.dispute_rule: Record the positions and neutral international status without choosing a sovereign or turning a physical feature into an administrative unit.
source_policy.chinese_name_rule: Prefer Chinese United Nations terminology, Unicode CLDR, or a competent Chinese government source. Existing project labels are explicitly marked pending when no authoritative Chinese source was located.

political_status.notes: The map label follows Unicode CLDR territory code PS. United Nations materials use context-dependent forms including the occupied Palestinian territory and the State of Palestine; this record does not determine final-status borders.

sources.source_authority: United Nations — Question of Palestine

adm2.notes: PCBS reports 580 localities in the West Bank and 33 in the Gaza Strip for the 2017 administrative division. A locality is an inhabited place with an independent local administration or a separated inhabited place outside another locality's formal boundary.

geometry_source.reason: The official GeoMOLG service exposes queryable governorate and local-government boundary layers, but its public metadata has no stated reuse license. PCBS maps are authoritative validation references, not licensed vector downloads.

political_status.notes: Somaliland operates a de facto regional and district administration. United Nations and Chinese government material treats it within Somalia and often places the name in quotation marks or calls it Somaliland State/region. The dataset must not imply recognition as a sovereign State.

sources.source_authority: United Nations Security Council
Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

adm1.notes: Somaliland government sources consistently describe six main regions, but some later documents also mention fourteen proposed or expanded regions. Use the six-region legal baseline until the competent authority publishes one unambiguous, licensed boundary release.

adm2.notes: A 2025 Somaliland government document reports 86 districts, of which 23 are electoral districts. The legal and cartographic status of later-created districts is not consistent enough for ingestion without a definitive official register.

geometry_source.reason: The competent authority confirms the hierarchy, but the reviewed official documents contain illustrative maps rather than a licensed, reproducible vector boundary release. Some eastern regions and districts are also contested by neighbouring administrations.

sources.source_authority: Government of Somaliland

political_status.notes: The International Court of Justice concluded in 2012 that Colombia has sovereignty over the islands at Bajo Nuevo. Colombian law includes the cays within the Department Archipelago of San Andrés, Providencia and Santa Catalina. The project must record this result without manufacturing a separate country hierarchy.

sources.source_authority: International Court of Justice
Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Colombia

geometry_source.reason: The cay/bank does not have its own municipal subdivisions. Attach it to Colombia/Archipelago Department in a future normalization rather than adding duplicate boundaries.

notes: No GeoJSON supplement is appropriate.

political_status.notes: Argentina and Chile signed the 1998 agreement defining the boundary course from Mount Fitz Roy to Cerro Daudet and assigned detailed 1:50,000 survey and demarcation work to their joint boundary commission. The ice field itself is a transboundary physical feature, not a country.
